leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that merges two sorted arrays into a single sorted array
Apply two-pointer technique to traverse both arrays simultaneously
Construct conditional logic to compare elements from both arrays
Initialize and manipulate result arrays while maintaining sorted order
Integrate edge case handling for arrays of different lengths
Control loop execution until all elements from both arrays are processed
Configure the merge algorithm to handle empty array inputs
